survivors_flagged.one_line: FDA accepted a May-2026 protocol amendment killing the interim and pulling the final analysis of J&J-sponsored Phase 3 NANORAY-312 forward on fewer events - an accelerated pivotal readout plus milestone payments on a thinly covered French micro-cap that has not re-rated.

Sale of the genomics unit to Zoetis for $160M (~$140M net) closes by end of first-half FY2027 with proceeds earmarked to take net debt/EBITDA under 3x by end of calendar 2026 - a dated deleveraging path on a badly broken-down asset, and the cash has not landed yet.

Sub-cash shell ($321M cap) with activist-installed board, definitive Markforged sale to Stratasys ($42.5M, closes 2H26) and a live proxy fight over strategy; price near 52w low ($1.53 vs $2.32 high) so the restructuring is un-rerated.

FCC draft NPRM on the 902-928MHz band reconfiguration sits at OMB/OIRA since March 2026 with a decision pending; stock de-rated to $13.87 vs $24.42 52w high and below both MAs, so the option is cheap - but the NPRM only opens rulemaking, final order is years out.

NRC Safety Evaluations of the docketed SOLO topical reports expected by October 2026 plus a Construction Permit Application targeted for late 2026; de-SPAC crushed from $21.90 to $5.11 so the hard dated milestones are unpriced, though it remains a pre-revenue story.

Definitive $750M de-SPAC with Abra (digital-asset wealth platform) signed 2026-03-16, outside date 2026-10-15, closing gated on S-4 effectiveness, vote, $40M net-cash minimum and Nasdaq listing - trust value floors the downside, but the target quality is poor and the closing conditions are genuinely at risk.

The genuine complicated merger-arb here: STB accepted the revised UP-NS application 2026-05-28 but held the proceeding (and environmental review) in ABEYANCE pending supplemental filings (first tranche filed 2026-07-07) - forward and unresolved, but announced July 2025, saturated with coverage, and the next hard date is only the procedural-schedule reset, so this is late-arc with regulatory tail risk rather than an early-arc entry.

Black Hills all-stock MOE (Bright Horizon): shareholders, HSR, FERC, Nebraska and South Dakota all cleared; only the contested Montana PSC final order remains, close targeted year-end 2026 - a real dated last-gate binary, not yet resolved.

Live all-cash merger arb: Sun Pharma at $14.00/sh, shareholder vote cleared 22 July 2026, remaining conditions are global antitrust and FDI with a 26 Jan 2027 outside date — a dated, definitive-agreement spread rather than a re-rate.

OPERA-01 palazestrant Phase 3 topline guided to fall 2026 — one real dated binary, months out and not yet run into, but a crowded single-asset oncology bet with no structural asymmetry beyond the readout.

Olin/Huntsman all-stock merger of equals with S-4 effective and both special meetings dated 25 Aug 2026 — dated and forward, but an all-stock MoE offers a ratio, not a cash spread, and the Q2 miss shows the underlying is the real exposure.

G2 PARTIAL (commitment is real - a licensed program with milestone obligations - but the amount is only "hundreds of millions in aggregate ... in the next few years", no per-milestone figure or trigger disclosed). G3 FAIL (no specific currently-unpriced figure; the $1.98B cap already embeds a large probability of success after a 6x).
verified.edge: L - the flagged event is fired and largely harvested. Run-up: pre-catalyst base 2026-05-04 close $31.16 (announcement day, pre-reaction) -> peak $55.07 on 5/14 (+77% in 8 sessions) -> $39.24 today = +25.9% still held from the base; on the 12-month view the re-rate is +544% off the $6.09 52wk low vs a $29.79 200d average, so the triage claim "has not re-rated" is factually wrong. Remaining capture to a favorable H1-2027 PFS readout is genuinely large in percentage terms but is the readout's payoff, not the amendment's - the amendment's own repricing is ~100% consumed and has already given back 29% from the peak. Management also monetized the pop with a ~$100M global offering closed 26 May 2026 at elevated prices, so the float that would have captured the move was diluted at the top.
verified.primary_source: Nanobiotix press release "Nanobiotix Announces Protocol Amendment to Ongoing Global Phase 3 Head and Neck Cancer Study", 4 May 2026 (via BioSpace/GlobeNewswire); corroborated by Nanobiotix Q1 2026 operational update, 2 June 2026 (GlobeNewswire) for the 283/335-event and 92%-power detail and the H1-2027 readout framing, and "NANOBIOTIX Announces Closing of Global Offering" (Euronext, 26 May 2026) for the ~$100M raise and runway-into-2029. Price data: FMP EOD/quote as of 2026-08-03 ($39.24; 52wk $6.09-$57.14; 200d avg $29.79).
verified.analysis: The event described in the triage flag is real and correctly characterised in its mechanics - J&J's amendment did eliminate the interim and pull the final analysis forward at improved 92% PFS power, FDA-accepted and announced 4 May 2026 - but two of the flag's three investment premises are false: it is not forward (it fired three months ago) and the stock has emphatically re-rated (+77% in the eight sessions after the news, +544% off the 52-week low, 200d average $29.79 vs $39.24 today). Nanobiotix then sold ~$100M of stock into the strength on 26 May 2026, funding operations into 2029 but capping the equity's own capture of the move. What remains is a legitimate pivotal binary - the modified final PFS analysis guided to H1 2027 - but it is undated, roughly ten months out, carries no disclosed milestone figure to underwrite against, and sits on a $2B market cap that already prices a meaningful probability of success; a failed readout on a single-asset partnered story plausibly takes the equity back toward the mid-teens.

verified.primary_source: Neogen press release "Neogen Announces Sale of Genomics Business to Zoetis," 2026-03-02 (investors.neogen.com / Businesswire 20260302002729) and Zoetis PR same date; leverage path and FY2027 guidance ($880-885M revenue, $180-182M adj EBITDA, <3x leverage by CY2026-end, ~2.5x by FY2027-end) from Neogen Q4/FY2026 results, 2026-07-30 (Businesswire 20260730889874, 8-K ex99_1); capital structure from the FY2026 balance sheet, period ended 2026-05-31, filed 2026-07-30.
verified.analysis: The flagged facts check out exactly as stated: a definitive $160M cash sale to a named strategic (Zoetis) signed 2026-03-02, proceeds committed to debt reduction, closing by end of 1H FY2027 (~2026-11-30), and management reaffirmed the sub-3x-by-CY2026-end path with FY2027 guidance on 2026-07-30 — real, dated, forward, non-macro, and genuinely unfired since the cash has not landed. Where it fails the DEEP bar is the numerator and the residual: the waterfall is clean (zero preferred, no manager fees) but that cuts against the case here, because with nothing to strip out the entire event is worth precisely the $140M of debt it retires, $0.64/share or ~5% on a $2.69B market cap — the flagged $160M headline is a balance-sheet shuffle, not a claim on an unpriced pool. Meanwhile the stock has re-rated +31.5% in four sessions to a 52-week high on the FY26 Q4 beat and now trades at ~18x guided FY2027 EBITDA for ~3% core growth, so the "badly broken-down asset" framing is five months stale; buying here is paying a full multiple for a receipt that was published in March. WATCH not ACTIVE: worth re-scoring only if the equity gives back the earnings pop toward the $8.50-9.50 shelf while the November close stays on track.

verified.primary_source: GlobeNewswire, "Nano Dimension and Murchinson Announce Agreement to Reconstitute the Company's Board of Directors" (2026-07-20; settlement 2026-07-17); Nano Dimension 8-K/press release "Announces Sale of MarkForged, Inc. to Stratasys" (2026-05-27); NNDM Q1-2026 balance sheet, SEC filing accepted 2026-05-07; CEO Stehlin shareholder letter (2026-06-05) on the three-phase plan and ~$441.6M pro-forma liquidity.
verified.analysis: The triage premise is partly stale: the proxy fight is NOT live — Nano Dimension and Murchinson settled on 2026-07-17 (announced 07-20), four incumbent directors resigned, Murchinson designees joined the board, and the July EGM was cancelled. That leg is fired, and the Markforged/Stratasys sale has been public since 2026-05-27, so the remaining "event" is an administrative close plus an undated Phase-3 decision. The numerator re-derivation is the decisive check and it is genuinely clean on the liability side — zero preferred, only $87.8M of total liabilities against $439.8M of cash and short-term investments — but it caps the honest upside at $1.67-$1.95/share (+10% to +28%), not a move back toward the $2.32 high; management explicitly frames Phase 3 as a merger/reverse-merger redeployment of that cash rather than a distribution, which is precisely why the discount persists and why Murchinson's public objection was value-destructive capital deployment. Residual capture is unusually favourable (run-up ~0%, the stock actually de-rated through both announcements), so this is not a VISN-style harvested receipt — but with no contractual path from the cash to the common, no dated distribution, and a burn that erodes ~$0.10-0.15/share/year, this is a cheap-to-cash equity to watch, not an event to underwrite. GAP: I did not pull the Q2-2026 10-Q (not yet filed as of 2026-08-03), so the cash figure is as of 2026-03-31 and one further quarter of burn is unmeasured; a re-check after the late-August Q2 print and a hard Markforged closing date would be the trigger to re-score.

verified.catalyst: FCC draft NPRM to reconfigure the Lower 900 MHz band (902-928 MHz) for NextNav's terrestrial 5G PNT network has sat at OMB/OIRA interagency review since March 2026 and has not yet been released.
verified.dated_milestone: No dated regulatory milestone exists - OIRA review carries no statutory deadline and no FCC open-meeting item has been circulated (Communications Daily 2026-06-23: NPRM "likely to come soon"; SIA on 2026-05-12 expected it "this summer" - both undated). Nearest hard date is the Q2 2026 earnings call on 2026-08-11 (announced 2026-07-23), which is a management update, not the event.
verified.bloom_gates: G1 partial only - Safran Electronics & Defense named as counterparty (2026-07-29) but the agreement is an interoperability demonstration with no disclosed economics, so it fails G2 (no concrete commitment). G3 fails outright: there is no specific currently-unpriced figure - the spectrum option IS the entire market cap.
verified.edge: L - run-up from the pre-catalyst base (petition filed publicly 2024-04, stock ~$2.50-3.00 pre-filing) to $13.87 today is roughly +400%; the de-rate from the $24.42 52w high gives back only part of that. Remaining capture to a favorable NPRM cannot be provenance-checked: an NPRM merely opens a docket, the final order is years out, and no defensible spectrum value sits above today's ~$1.6B EV on ~$25M revenue. Best-case reversion to the 52w high is ~+76%, but that is a trading number, not a derived one.
verified.primary_source: Communications Daily 2026-06-23 ("FCC NPRM Likely to Come Soon Based on NextNav's PNT Plan: New Street") and 2026-05-12 (SIA expects an NPRM this summer), confirming the draft NPRM went to OMB/OIRA in March 2026 and remained under interagency review; NextNav Q1 2026 10-Q filed 2026-05-14; NextNav press releases 2026-06-30 (warrant + convertible note redemption) and 2026-07-29 (Safran agreement); FMP quote 2026-08-03 ($13.8659).
verified.analysis: The event is real and genuinely unfired - the draft NPRM has been at OIRA since March 2026 and no release has occurred as of 2026-08-03 - but it fails the DATED gate (OIRA review has no deadline; the only guidance is "soon"/"this summer") and it is procedural: an NPRM opens comment cycles, it does not grant spectrum, with a final order years out and House appropriators having cleared an amendment barring FCC funds from implementing the plan. On residual capture, the catalyst has been publicly knowable since the April 2024 petition; the stock is up roughly 400% from that pre-event base, and the 43% de-rate from the $24.42 high reflects timeline slippage plus the June-30 warrant redemption at $11.50 (marginal dilution struck only 21% below today's price), not an unpriced option. Capital-structure check shows nothing hidden to unlock: negative book equity, $281M debt against $143M liquid at Q1, ~$25M revenue, so the entire $1.9B cap is the regulatory bet itself - score the equity, not the event, and cap at 4. WATCH pending an actual circulated/adopted NPRM date; the 2026-08-11 Q2 call is the next place management timing guidance could produce a real dated milestone.
